chunks: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the fasting person who is struck by thirst until he fears for his life. He said: 'He drinks enough to sustain his life, and does not drink until he is fully satisfied.'
ai.seo_question: How much should a fasting person drink when they fear death from severe thirst?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of 'darura' (necessity) in fiqh, where the preservation of life overrides the obligation of fasting. It introduces a nuanced legal distinction between drinking merely enough to survive (preserving 'ramaq') and drinking to satiation, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on proportionality in lifting restrictions. This ruling underscores the balance between the sanctity of the fast and the practical reality of human physiological limits.
